answers.p1: No, delimiters are never auto-detected; you pass `--delimiter` (default comma).
answers.p2: Numeric columns need a `.` decimal separator.
answers.p3: Exit code 3 signals a data error such as a bad number.
answers.p5: New tests read their input from files in `samples/`, not inline strings.
answers.p6: `--delimiter` and `--count` are done; exit-code handling has not been started.
answers.p7: Exit-code handling first, then `--output json`, then README docs.
